caption: The drawing depicts a single blue glass bowl positioned centrally against a plain, beige background. The bowl has a wide, flared rim that curves smoothly outward and a body that tapers downward. The base of the bowl features a series of evenly spaced, wavy projections or undulations that add decorative detail. The glass is semi-transparent, with varying intensities of blue indicating thickness and light reflection.
